sections.Profile:
"Tiger Woman" is a four-player solid-state pinball machine from I.D.I., built to run on Gottlieb System 1 electronics.

- Manufacturer: I.D.I.
- Years made: 1982
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
- Tags: Conversion Kit, Women, Original Theme, Solid State, Fantasy, 1980s
